operation: Merge through existing runBallotPublication({state,directory}) in scripts/assemble-ballot-package.mts. Local packet prepared offline only; no production writer has run. Existing statewide, legislative, judiciary and unrelated local facts stay unchanged.

validation.crossCountySchoolIdentityReuse: PASS: three shared Los Angeles race IDs and corresponding candidate IDs reused in cumulative merge
validation.countyCompleteMeaning: All138 county-qualified local printed-candidate office blocks; reader geography and separately declared write-in display remain open.

coverage.judicialCoverage: Statewide Supreme Court and Fourth Appellate District retention contests already held in ca.json; exact existing IDs preserved by omission from this local packet. County qualified-contest list has no Superior Court general-election contest.
coverage.declaredWriteIns: County current election page lists Maryann Verghese for Rancho Santa Margarita District 4. Saved separately; not mixed into the complete printed sample-ballot list.
coverage.completenessBasis: Complete named candidate blocks from actual official sample-ballot pages; official county qualified roster is a crosscheck and gap inventory, never a substitute for missing sample pages.
coverage.scope: All 138 local named-candidate contests qualified by the county for November 3 2026: 47 school/community-college, 2 county supervisor, 77 municipal and 12 special district contests. Statewide/legislative/judicial races were already held and preserved. Local measures are outside this candidate packet.
